hints.title: Choose the last balloon
hints.body: Instead of deciding which balloon bursts first, decide which balloon in an interval bursts last. At that moment its neighbors are the interval boundaries.

hints.title: Pad the row
hints.body: Add a 1 at each end. These sentinels never burst but provide the outside values for the first and last balloons.

hints.title: Interval DP
hints.body: Let `dp[left][right]` be the best bounty from bursting all balloons strictly between two boundary indices. Try every balloon `last` in that gap as the final one: `dp[left][last] + values[left] * values[last] * values[right] + dp[last][right]`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
values = [1] + nums + [1]
dp = zeros of size (n + 2) x (n + 2)
for length from 2 to n + 1:
    for left from 0 to n + 1 - length:
        right = left + length
        for last from left + 1 to right - 1:
            dp[left][right] = max(
                dp[left][right],
                dp[left][last] + values[left] * values[last] * values[right] + dp[last][right])
return dp[0][n + 1]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete implementation.
